item.title: Update CHANGELOG.md and bump version to v0.3.7
item.intent: CHANGELOG.md must document BUG-116 (--remove-ac flag) and BUG-117 (auto start queued item count log) under a new [0.3.7] entry, and VERSION must be updated to 0.3.7.
item.description: BUG-116 (--remove-ac N flag for backlog edit) and BUG-117 (queued item count with priority breakdown logged on auto start) were implemented after the 0.3.6 release but are not reflected in CHANGELOG.md or VERSION. Standard release hygiene: any merged feature or fix batch should result in a documented version increment.
steps: In docs/CHANGELOG.md, add a new ## [0.3.7] - 2026-03-21 section above [0.3.6]
Under ### Added, document BUG-117: 'Queued item count with per-priority breakdown logged at auto session start (BUG-117)'
Under ### Added, document BUG-116: '--remove-ac N flag for backlog edit to remove a specific acceptance criterion by 1-based index (BUG-116)'
Run .aishore/aishore version to confirm it now reports 0.3.7
Run .aishore/aishore checksums to regenerate checksums after editing .aishore/VERSION
acceptanceCriteria: CHANGELOG.md has a [0.3.7] section with BUG-116 and BUG-117 entries
.aishore/checksums.sha256 is regenerated and up to date
shellcheck passes with zero new warnings
